name: bank-statement-consolidator
description: Extract, classify, reconcile, and consolidate bank-statement transactions into a template-driven Excel workbook.

interface.longDescription: Processes bank statements locally, applies editable Excel mapping and category rules, reconciles extracted transactions, and creates transaction, debit, P&L, and consolidated reporting views.
defaultPrompt: Create a template-driven consolidated workbook from these bank statements.
Validate my workbook rules and extract these statements into the master table.
Build a reconciled debit, P&L, and consolidated statement report.
